dimensions.reason: The review correctly reconciles the revision-2 brief with accepted decisions, distinguishes draft decisions and release notes from requirements, and explicitly confirms compliant creator-navigation and favorites behavior.

Findings respect the existing controller, lifecycle, policy, and host-application boundaries. Recommendations are narrowly placed, such as separating search replacement semantics from refresh and reusing canAcquire rather than introducing new infrastructure.

All four reported behavioral defects are supported directly by the supplied source and targeted reproductions: stale pagination after failed replacement search, retry using the current draft, incomplete foreground refresh, and inconsistent acquisition enablement without an activity ID.

The response accurately reports the 10/10 passing suite while explaining its coverage gaps, and targeted executable examples substantiate each behavioral finding. It also appropriately limits browser and host-level claims to what the snapshot can establish.

The review is prioritized, specific, actionable, and concise. Each finding identifies location, observable consequence, violated contract, and an appropriate remediation or missing test without overstating certainty.

evidence_limits: The React host and browser harness are absent, so actual URL/filter integration, reactive favorite rendering, keyboard behavior, and screenshot provenance cannot be independently assessed.
The rubric text is withheld, so scoring is based only on the named dimensions and supplied evidence.
